_source: Adapted for the Sets film (A) from the introduction film's glossary, plus the Set wording rules the user enforced (knowledge brief §4, cents-bot glossary).

forbidden_phrases.why: Narration speaks the ideas directly; attribution belongs in the credits.
He died in February 2025. The house guidance is past tense throughout.
Do not generalise across the collector base; it is not measured.
Sets are emergent structures identified within the collection, never collecting goals (user rule).
There is no Corroded Set; the user's correction is 'Contaminated sets not Corroded sets'.
It is the Full Mint Set.
Copper was struck through 1982: say pre-1983 or pre-zinc.
No rarity scores; value is the frame, not scarcity rankings.
Deictics resolve to the source's date; holder counts especially must carry their own date (essay block [7]).

distinct_terms.why: CENTS = the project; Cents = the collection pieces; cents = ordinary money.
The physical block the coins were smelted into, versus the inscription OF its 3D model.
The unit, its inscription, the image and the physical penny are four things.
Cumulative production since 1909 versus the population surviving now. 500+ billion and 288 billion answer different questions.

must_not_equate.why: Circulation made the marks; the Trait Council named them. Not algorithmic, and not from the artist.

must_not_equate.b: the reason Chang chose the penny
must_not_equate.why: A property of the readymade is not a motive. The source gives the origin as a value discrepancy.
The work's claim is that its value goes on being redefined after the coin stops being made.
Identified structures, not targets the project set.
The Council identified the Sets after the work was released; Chang made neither the trait names nor the Sets.
